content: In line with the simple measures presented above, both networks in Figure FIGREF24 exhibit generally decreasing levels of polarization towards the end of the Cold War and then subsequent increases or stagnation afterwards. Interestingly, the speech network displays slightly higher levels of polarization than the ideal point network. This indicates that more heterogeneity exists in speeches than votes, and aligns with Figure 1 and Figure 2a in the main body of the paper.
